  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC
 The consent calendar shall be heard immediately after the pledge of allegiance, and prior to 6:30
 PM. All matters listed under the Consent Calendar are to be considered routine by the City Council
 and will all be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of said items unless the
 Mayor, City Councilmembers or the City Manager request specific items be discussed and/or
 removed from the Consent Calendar for separate action.

 CONSENT CALENDAR (1 – 9)

 1.  25-54373  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $500, offset by the First Council District One-Time District
  Priority Funds, transferred from the Citywide Activities Department, to provide a
  donation to the following:
  1. Black Employees Association of Long Beach, in support of the Black History
  Month Celebration, in the amount of $500; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $500, to offset transfers to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Mary Zendejas, Councilwoman, First District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54374  Recommendation to increase appropriations in the General Fund Group in the City
  Manager Department by $2,000, offset by the Third Council District One-Time

  provide contributions of:
  1. $500 to Long Beach Nonprofit Partnership in support of Long Beach Gives
  for the Long Beach Gives campaign;
  2. $1,500 to the Temple Israel for Make a Difference Day; and

  Decrease appropriations in the General Fund Group in the Citywide Activities
  Department by $2,000, to offset a transfer to the City Manager Department.

  Office or Department:  Kristina Duggan, Councilmember, Third District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  February 4, 2025.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  between February 3, 2025 and February 10, 2025.

  Office or Department:  City Clerk

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  contract to City Fabrick, of Long Beach, CA, to develop an Urban Forest Master
  Plan for the City of Long Beach, in an annual amount of $247,100, authorize a
  contingency in the amount of $2,900, for a total annual amount not to exceed
  $250,000, for a period of two years, with the option to renew for three additional
  one-year periods, at the discretion of the City Manager; and, authorize City
  Manager, or designee, to execute all documents necessary to enter into the
  contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  City Manager

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54292  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute two
  contracts, and any necessary documents, including any subsequent amendments
  (including the option to the term) between the Long Beach Unified School District
  of Los Angeles County and the Long Beach Fire Department, for the Junior
  Lifeguard Summer Program, including preparation class staffing hours in the

  recipients for a period estimated to begin June 1, 2025 through August 31, 2029 at

  Department by $36,760, offset by Long Beach Unified School District revenue.
  (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Fire Department

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 37113 with American Landscape,

  purchase and installation of irrigation controllers, to increase the annual contract
  amount by $63,571, inclusive of a 10 percent contingency, for a revised total
  annual amount not to exceed $383,071. (District 1)

  Office or Department:  Parks, Recreation and Marine

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  at 1320 Atlantic Avenue, for public sidewalk widening purposes. (District 6)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Park Expansion Project, to increase the contingency amount by $85,848, for a
  revised contract amount not to exceed $6,642,888. (District 8)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Office or Department:  Rex Richardson, Mayor

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Department and other key city departments to establish a new citywide Small
  Business Rebound initiative to develop and expand innovative strategies that help
  recruit, retain, and reinforce local small businesses, include recommendations in
  the FY 26 budget development process to support these strategies, and refer to
  the Economic Development and Opportunity Committee for input and discussion.

  Sixth District, Chair, Economic Development and
  Opportunity Committee

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Unit Annual Plan (July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026) and Program Plan (July 1, 2025
  to June 30, 2030) and find the action is not subject to the California Environmental
  Quality Act as set forth in the discussion herein. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Energy Resources

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  District Priority Funds for City Council District infrastructure projects and existing
  programs; and

  Approve related budget appropriation adjustments for Fiscal Year 2025 in
  accordance with existing City Council policy. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Financial Management

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 25-54305  Recommendation to authorize City Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to amend Contract No. 36531 with Kleinfelder, Inc., of San
  Diego, CA, for providing engineering consulting services for the 2nd Street Bridge

  $1,042,844, for a revised contract amount not to exceed $1,593,035;

  Increase appropriations in the Capital Projects Fund Group in the Public Works
  Department by $1,239,420, offset by Federal Highway Bridge Program (HBP)
  funds from the California Department of Transportation (BHLS-5108(197)); and

  Increase appropriations in the Capital Projects Fund Group in the Department of
  Public Works Department by $1,239,420, offset by transfer of Federal Highway
  Bridge Program (HBP) funds from the Capital Grant Fund. (District 3)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

18. 25-54226  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Public Works
  Department regarding local flood management and storm preparation and
  response. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Public Works

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

ORDINANCE

  execute a contract, and any necessary documents including any necessary
  subsequent amendments, with DocuPet Corp, of East Syracuse, NY, for providing
  pet licensing services, for a period of one year, with the option to renew for four
  additional one-year periods, at the discretion of the City Manager; and

  25-54295  Declare Proposition “L” ordinance read the first time and laid over to the next
  regular meeting of the City Council for final reading, which pursuant to Section
  1806 of the City Charter, makes findings and determines regarding contracting of
  licensing services. (Citywide)

  Levine Act: Yes

  Office or Department:  Parks, Recreation and Marine

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

20. 25-54047  WITHDRAWN
  Recommendation to declare ordinance adopting Zoning Code Amendment
  (ZCA24-003) and the proposed findings related thereto, to amend Chapter 21.67 of

  applicability beyond the Downtown Plan (PD-30) and Mid-Town Specific Plan (SP-

  zone; change the affordability requirements for Inclusionary Housing units; and
  implement other changes to the Inclusionary Housing Ordinance, read and
  adopted as read. (Citywide)

  Office or Department:  Community Development

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

NEW BUSINESS

21. 25-54395  Recommendation to request a report to City Council at the March 4th City Council

  options for City Council to consider to extend and enhance the pilot for both FY 25
  and in future budget years.

  Office or Department:  Cindy Allen, Councilwoman, Second District; Daryl
  Supernaw, Councilman, Fourth District; Megan Kerr,
  Councilwoman, Fifth District

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Tuesday, February 18, 2025 – Government Operations and Efficiency Committee (Attorney/Client) at

Tuesday, March 4, 2025 – As the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency of the City of
Long Beach at 4:45 P.M., Civic Chambers.

HEARING REMINDER

Tuesday, March 11, 2025 - Hearing for the Refuse, Recycling and Organics Rates under a two-step
rate adjustment.
